name: Paper
notes: Paper, parchment and books: notes, scrolls, posters, screens. Ignites at 230 °C (the classic '451 °F') and flashes out in 8 s. Density 800 kg/m³ for a sheet stack, so it floats. Nearly no structure (5 hp). A little rustle underfoot (+1 dB). Burns away completely (mw-e03.5). Soft surface; not a rope-arrow anchor. (mw-e03.31) Paper is cellulose fibre and soaks through (0.8) (mw-e03.59).
